# Projects

A project is any directory with a `project.json`. Every project has a README.md. Almost all are TypeScript packages with a `package.json`. A `go.mod` makes a Go project (see [create-package](../create-package/SKILL.md#go-projects)), and a `Cargo.toml` a Rust one (see [Rust projects](../create-package/SKILL.md#rust-projects)): [`go`](../../../tools/constant-consistent-hash/go/) is only Go, and [`test-vectors`](../../../tools/constant-consistent-hash/test-vectors/) is both an npm package and a Go module.

- `tools/`: libraries consumed via `import`.
- `apps/`: CLIs, Nx plugins, and larger packages that are used other than by plain `import`.
- `leyman/`: the repo's own tooling: shared configs and global tools. Most are private; `@leyman/configs`, `@leyman/eslint-config`, `@leyman/expect` and `@leyman/nx-plugin` are published.
- `docs/`: the documentation site (private, never published). See its [README](../../../docs/README.md).
- `e2e/`: private, test-only packages that check several packages together, in ways no single package can (e.g. because depending on each other would be circular). See [create-package](../create-package/SKILL.md#e2e-packages).
- `infra/`: deployed, never-published infrastructure, e.g. the hosted Nx cache (`infra/nx-cache`: a Worker, and the OpenTofu configuration of its Cloudflare resources). See its [README](../../../infra/nx-cache/README.md).
- `demos/`: private, never-published worked examples of using open-source projects and services well (e.g. a cache on Valkey), tested against the real services. See [create-package](../create-package/SKILL.md#demo-packages).

## Packages

**The tables below are generated** by [`populate-docs.mjs`](../../../docs/scripts/populate-docs.mjs): a section per top-level folder, and each project's `package.json` `description` (which its README's subtitle repeats), or `metadata.description` in its `project.json` when it has no `package.json`. After adding, removing or describing a project, run `nx run @leyman/docs:populate-files`, which also updates the root README; CI fails when they're out of date. A new top-level folder needs a section in the script. Edit this file only inside its manual sections.

**When you remove a published package, add it to the top of [`DEPRECATED_PACKAGES.md`](../../../DEPRECATED_PACKAGES.md)**, linking its source at the last commit before the removal.

See each package's README.md for full usage documentation.
<!-- @manual-end intro -->

### Apps

| Project                                                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                               |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`barrelify`](../../../apps/barrelify/)                                     | Generate and CI-verify TypeScript barrel (index.ts) files with the correct ESM/CJS import extensions.                                                                                     |
| [`check-package`](../../../apps/check-package/)                             | Check an npm package as it would be published, running publint, Are The Types Wrong, a strict typecheck of its declarations, and checks of its Node.js support floor and published files. |
| [`genever`](../../../apps/genever/ts/)                                      | Generate TypeScript types from JSON Schema files and OpenAPI documents, with strict schema checks and the same types Juniper infers.                                                      |
| [`genever-content-mapper`](../../../apps/genever-content-mapper/)           | A TypeScript 7.1 content mapper that gives an imported OpenAPI document or JSON Schema file genever's types, without a generated file. (private, on `catalog:typescript-next`)            |
| [`genever-go`](../../../apps/genever/go/)                                   | Generate Go types from JSON Schema files and OpenAPI documents, with the same strict schema checks as genever. (private, Go)                                                              |
| [`genever-test-vectors`](../../../apps/genever/test-vectors/)               | Schemas and sample values shared by every genever implementation: Juniper fixtures and schemas genever rejects, as TypeScript, and as JSON for the Go implementation. (private)           |
| [`juniper`](../../../apps/juniper/)                                         | A JSON Schema builder for TypeScript that infers each schema's type and catches schema mistakes at compile time, with JSON Schema 2020-12 and OpenAPI 3.0 output.                         |
| [`juniper-arbitrary`](../../../apps/juniper-arbitrary/)                     | fast-check arbitraries from Juniper schemas.                                                                                                                                              |
| [`juniper-validator`](../../../apps/juniper-validator/)                     | StandardSchema-compliant validator for Juniper schemas.                                                                                                                                   |
| [`load-populate-files`](../../../apps/populate-files/load-populate-files/)  | Load and dynamically populate file content based on a single file's config.                                                                                                               |
| [`nx-lifecycle`](../../../apps/nx-lifecycle/)                               | Nx plugin that derives every dependsOn from declared lifecycle stages (build, test, …) and the targets bound to them.                                                                     |
| [`pg-dolly-schema`](../../../apps/pg-dolly-schema/)                         | Keep a schema.sql of what your Postgres migrations build, for any migration tool, and fail CI when the committed file is stale.                                                           |
| [`populate-files`](../../../apps/populate-files/ts/)                        | Populate static files with dynamic content, and make sure they stay in sync.                                                                                                              |
| [`populate-files-go`](../../../apps/populate-files/go/)                     | Go implementation of populate-files, tested against the shared test vectors. (private, Go)                                                                                                |
| [`populate-files-test-vectors`](../../../apps/populate-files/test-vectors/) | Test vectors shared by every populate-files implementation. (private)                                                                                                                     |
| [`trusted-tsc`](../../../apps/trusted-tsc/)                                 | Run TypeScript 7.1's tsc with only the content mappers you trust, each in Node's permission sandbox. (private, on `catalog:typescript-next`)                                              |

### Tools

| Project                                                                                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`constant-consistent-hash`](../../../tools/constant-consistent-hash/ts/)                        | Stateless consistent hashing in constant time with no loops, which only moves keys into a newly added bucket. Specified so any language can return the same buckets.       |
| [`constant-consistent-hash-go`](../../../tools/constant-consistent-hash/go/)                     | Go implementation of constant-consistent-hash, tested against the shared test vectors. (private, Go)                                                                       |
| [`constant-consistent-hash-rust`](../../../tools/constant-consistent-hash/rust/)                 | Rust implementation of constant-consistent-hash, compiled to WASM for TypeScript, and tested against the shared test vectors. (private, Rust)                              |
| [`constant-consistent-hash-test-vectors`](../../../tools/constant-consistent-hash/test-vectors/) | Test vectors shared by every constant-consistent-hash implementation. (private, Go, Rust)                                                                                  |
| [`constant-consistent-hash-wasm`](../../../tools/constant-consistent-hash/wasm/)                 | constant-consistent-hash from TypeScript, through its Rust implementation compiled to WASM, on Node.js and in browsers. (private)                                          |
| [`default-import`](../../../tools/default-import/)                                               | Properly handle CJS default imports in ESM.                                                                                                                                |
| [`entry-script`](../../../tools/entry-script/)                                                   | Node.js scripts whose main() only runs when they are the entry point, so tests can import them without side effects.                                                       |
| [`enum-to-array`](../../../tools/enum-to-array/)                                                 | Convert TypeScript enums to a strongly typed array.                                                                                                                        |
| [`find-import`](../../../tools/find-import/)                                                     | Find and load the first matching JS/JSON file by searching parent directories.                                                                                             |
| [`format-file`](../../../tools/format-file/)                                                     | Format files and text with Biome or Prettier, whichever the project uses.                                                                                                  |
| [`generated-signature`](../../../tools/generated-signature/ts/)                                  | Sign generated files so hand edits are detected, while keeping manual sections editable.                                                                                   |
| [`generated-signature-go`](../../../tools/generated-signature/go/)                               | Go implementation of generated-signature, tested against the shared test vectors. (private, Go)                                                                            |
| [`generated-signature-test-vectors`](../../../tools/generated-signature/test-vectors/)           | Test vectors shared by every generated-signature implementation. (private)                                                                                                 |
| [`haywire`](../../../tools/haywire/)                                                             | Dependency injection for TypeScript that checks the wiring at compile time, without decorators or reflect-metadata.                                                        |
| [`haywire-launcher`](../../../tools/haywire-launcher/)                                           | Instantiate and execute your haywire-managed entry script in one line.                                                                                                     |
| [`idempotency-keys`](../../../tools/idempotency-keys/ts/)                                        | Server-side support for the Idempotency-Key header, so clients can safely retry a POST. Works across instances, on Postgres or Valkey.                                     |
| [`idempotency-keys-go`](../../../tools/idempotency-keys/go/)                                     | Server-side support for the Idempotency-Key header in Go, so clients can safely retry a POST. Works across instances, on Postgres or Valkey. (private, Go)                 |
| [`idempotency-keys-test-vectors`](../../../tools/idempotency-keys/test-vectors/)                 | Test vectors shared by every idempotency-keys implementation. (private)                                                                                                    |
| [`iso-crypto`](../../../tools/iso-crypto/)                                                       | Cryptography with one API in browsers and Node.js, over WebCrypto and node:crypto, for hashing, AES encryption (including GCM), PBKDF2 and HKDF key derivation, and ECDH.  |
| [`lease-cache`](../../../tools/lease-cache/)                                                     | A read-through cache for Valkey or Redis that shares one load per key across all your servers, and handles invalidating a key while it loads.                              |
| [`local-ingress`](../../../tools/local-ingress/)                                                 | One HTTPS reverse proxy per machine, shared by every repo, that serves each devcontainer at its own `https://<worktree>.<repo>.localhost` through Docker labels. (private) |
| [`mocha-chain`](../../../tools/test-chain/mocha-chain/)                                          | Chain mocha BDD methods together for deterministic and type safe tests.                                                                                                    |
| [`normalized-react-query`](../../../tools/normalized-react-query/)                               | Type-safe TanStack Query definitions that pair each key with its fetcher, and link related queries so they prefetch together.                                              |
| [`oauth-dev-server`](../../../tools/oauth-dev-server/)                                           | A local OAuth 2.1 authorization server for tests, built on oidc-provider with a dev login, that issues audience-bound JWT access tokens through the real flow. (private)   |
| [`parse-cwd`](../../../tools/parse-cwd/)                                                         | Convert a relative path or URL to an absolute directory path.                                                                                                              |
| [`pg-dolly`](../../../tools/pg-dolly/)                                                           | A fresh Postgres database for every test, cloned from a template built once from your schema's SQL.                                                                        |
| [`punycode-esm`](../../../tools/punycode-esm/)                                                   | ESM and TypeScript port of the punycode.js library.                                                                                                                        |
| [`static-emitter`](../../../tools/static-emitter/)                                               | Statically typed event emitter.                                                                                                                                            |
| [`test-chain-core`](../../../tools/test-chain/test-chain-core/)                                  | Framework-agnostic internals for chaining test hooks with typed context.                                                                                                   |
| [`unknown-error`](../../../tools/unknown-error/)                                                 | Turn any caught `unknown` into a real Error without throwing, even for hostile values, other realms and deep or circular cause chains.                                     |
| [`vitest-chain`](../../../tools/test-chain/vitest-chain/)                                        | Chain vitest hooks together for deterministic and type safe tests.                                                                                                         |
| [`weighted-rendezvous-hash`](../../../tools/constant-consistent-hash/weighted-rendezvous-hash/)  | Weighted rendezvous hashing, where nodes can be added, removed or resized anywhere and each gets a share of keys in proportion to its size.                                |

### Leyman

| Project                                           | Description                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`configs`](../../../leyman/configs/)             | Strict TypeScript, SWC, c8, Biome and Vitest configs for TypeScript ESM packages, with a tsconfig for each Node.js support floor.                                               |
| [`eslint-config`](../../../leyman/eslint-config/) | An ESLint flat config for TypeScript ESM packages with nearly every rule on and a reason given for each exception, generated from each package's package.json.                  |
| [`expect`](../../../leyman/expect/)               | Chai's expect and assert with chai-as-promised registered, as one ESM import, so async assertions work in any test file without setup.                                          |
| [`framework`](../../../leyman/framework/)         | Audits how much of the leyman framework a repository has adopted, tier by tier, with the fix for each gap.                                                                      |
| [`main`](../../../leyman/main/)                   | Holds the repo's global tools and repo-wide scripts, without exposing them to every package. (private)                                                                          |
| [`nx-plugin`](../../../leyman/nx-plugin/)         | An Nx plugin that infers the build, test, lint and package-check targets of TypeScript ESM packages from their files, with each target hashing only what its result depends on. |
| [`vscode-tests`](../../../leyman/vscode-tests/)   | Run and debug a single test from VS Code, with a play button next to each test and suite and in the Testing panel. (private)                                                    |

### Demos

| Project                                                            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`agents/cli`](../../../demos/agents/cli/)                         | A CLI for the notes API, made for agents as well as people, with one short command per task and login, tokens and errors handled inside.                                                                                                     |
| [`agents/mcp`](../../../demos/agents/mcp/)                         | An MCP server that gives AI agents a few task-shaped tools over the notes API, and calls the API as the agent's user through OAuth token exchange.                                                                                           |
| [`blake3-go/go`](../../../demos/blake3-go/go/)                     | BLAKE3 from Rust through WASM, called from Go with wazero, and measured against BLAKE3 in Go. (Go)                                                                                                                                           |
| [`blake3-go/rust`](../../../demos/blake3-go/rust/)                 | BLAKE3 from the blake3 crate, compiled to WASM with SIMD behind a C ABI, and embedded for Go. (Go, Rust)                                                                                                                                     |
| [`blake3-wasm/rust`](../../../demos/blake3-wasm/rust/)             | BLAKE3 from the blake3 crate, compiled to WASM with SIMD, for the BLAKE3 through WASM demo. (Rust)                                                                                                                                           |
| [`blake3-wasm/typescript`](../../../demos/blake3-wasm/typescript/) | BLAKE3 from Rust through WASM with SIMD, on Node.js and in browsers, run blocking or in a worker, and measured against JavaScript to find where WASM pays off.                                                                               |
| [`local-ingress`](../../../demos/local-ingress/)                   | A Vite dev server behind tools/local-ingress, so each worktree is served at https://<worktree>.<repo>.localhost with hot reload through the proxy.                                                                                           |
| [`openapi/client`](../../../demos/openapi/client/)                 | A typed client for the OpenAPI demo's notes API, with types imported from the spec through a content mapper and routes read from openapi.json at runtime. (on `catalog:typescript-next`)                                                     |
| [`openapi/database`](../../../demos/openapi/database/)             | The Postgres schema for the OpenAPI demo, with its Drizzle tables, the migrations that build them, and a schema.sql snapshot of the result for tests to clone.                                                                               |
| [`openapi/server`](../../../demos/openapi/server/)                 | The notes API for the OpenAPI demo, a Hono server on Postgres with Drizzle that validates every request and response against openapi.json, and checks bearer tokens (static tokens or JWTs) and their scopes. (on `catalog:typescript-next`) |
| [`openapi/spec`](../../../demos/openapi/spec/)                     | The OpenAPI document of the OpenAPI demo's notes API, built from Juniper schemas and published as openapi.json and notes.openapi.yaml.                                                                                                       |
| [`read-through-cache`](../../../demos/read-through-cache/)         | A read-through cache on Valkey built from BentoCache and lease-cache, with a memory tier, stale-while-revalidate, one load per key across instances, and sharding with weighted rendezvous hashing.                                          |
